segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I’ve got Northstar at 38 current seats, term through September 30, and you were looking at adding the service desk team before October, right?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. We need 12 more seats, so 50 total. The only wrinkle is finance wants the invoice dated October 1, not September, because it hits the new quarter.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s fine. For 50 seats on the Business plan, annual billing, it comes to $54,000 for the year. Same support level you have now, and the added seats would be active on October 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Does that include the two admin seats for IT, or are those separate?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. The 50 is named users, and the admin permissions don’t change the count. If you want the sandbox environment, that’s the separate $3,600 line item, but you don’t have it today.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We can skip sandbox for now. Legal already approved the standard terms last year. Are there any changes in the renewal language?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No material changes. It’s a 12-month renewal, October 1 through September 30 next year, net 30 payment terms, and the same data processing addendum from your current agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Send the order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement. He’ll issue the PO once I approve it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it this afternoon with the 50 seats, October 1 start, annual invoice, net 30. Once it’s signed, onboarding will schedule the 30-minute admin review for the new managers.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If we get the order form today, I can sign by Friday. Go-live for the service desk group is October 7, so that timing works.
